title: Coherent states in quantum billiards constructed in the basis of the continued eigenfunctions
abstract: In the article a new approach to construction of generalized coherent states in quantum billiards is proposed. The coherent states are defined as the projections of a Gaussian wave function on the basis of the eigenstates of the quantum billiard, continued outside. The continuation is built as the solution of the equivalent Balian--Bloch equation, defined on the entire $\mathbb{R}^2$ and the projection operator is built using the resolvent of the Balian--Bloch equation. In the case of the one--dimensional potential well and billiards, belonging to the Coxeter group, the wave functions of the coherent states were expressed analytically via the Jacobi and Riemann theta functions.

bite.hook: New mathematical approach constructs generalized coherent states in quantum billiards using the Balian-Bloch equation.
tldr: Proposed a new approach to construct generalized coherent states in quantum billiards by projecting a Gaussian wave function.
Built the continued wave function outside the billiard as the solution to the equivalent Balian-Bloch equation on the entire plane.
Expressed coherent state wave functions analytically via Jacobi and Riemann theta functions for Coxeter group billiards.
bite.whyItMatters: Understanding quantum behavior in confined spaces is crucial for foundational quantum mechanics and nanotechnology. This method provides exact analytical tools for complex quantum systems.
bite.eli5: Imagine a particle bouncing inside a billiard table following quantum rules instead of normal physics. This research figures out a clever mathematical way to map out how waves of these particles behave even outside their normal boundaries.
